corrections.caveats: Enricher: the size-class test is strict (n < sizes[i]), so exact 32/64/128-byte requests skip their class (128-byte objects fall to ::operator new); freed slots are never reused, so after N lifetime allocations per class each call pays the class scan, the mutex and ::operator new and runs slower than the baseline; ::operator delete(p, alloc) skips destructors; std::function and std::pair moves are timed on both sides, diluting the 10%; the file relies on <cstdlib> arriving through other headers.
